description: Flags risks in a legal document: one-sided clauses, unlimited liability exposure, auto-renewal traps, broad non-compete clauses, vague/ambiguous language, missing standard protections (limitation of liability, indemnification caps), and IP assignment concerns. Returns flagged risks with severity ratings, excerpts, recommendations, and a risk score from 0 (minimal) to 100 (critical).

document_text.description: The full text of the legal document to assess for risks.

name: find_risks
